title: Auto-integrator has no dedicated merge checkout and runtime pointers disagree
summary: Resolved auto-integrator fail-closed rejection and runtime pointer drift across deployment infrastructure. Configured dedicated absolute integration_path for repository pantheon in .orchestrator/config.json; updated sync-dev-root.sh to install and verify supervisor watchdog unit and auto-integrator cron runner across all promotion pathways; added --verify flag to supervisor_watchdog_install.py; fixed stale home directory assumptions in auto_integrator.py and added explicit stderr alerting on live execute authority binding failures. Verified with 12 passing tests in test_sync_dev_root.py, 154 passing tests in test_auto_integrator.py, zero recurring cron failures, and successful live end-to-end integration of review-approved PRs #5918 and #5919.

pantheon_dedicated_integration_path.isolation: Dedicated clean integration checkout, distinct from worker worktrees and source checkout
